title: Professional Email Seat Catch-Up of Unbilled Seats
content:
**Scope.** A seat catch-up is the billing of the seats a Professional Email subscription carries beyond the seats billed for its current term, and this rule prices only a seat catch-up; seats added and billed when they were added remain under the seat change rules.

**Rule.** A seat catch-up may be billed only while the subscription status is active; it is one added-seat line for the current term on record, from the term start date to the term end date, on every billing plan, and it never changes the seat count.

**What the customer sees.** A new added-seat line in the email billing history, charged to the default card on file, covering the current term from the term start date to the term end date; the licensed seat count, the plan and the term dates stay as they were.

## Tool: `bill_unbilled_mail_seats_5cd17f30`

**Capability.** Bills, on the customer's default card, seats an email subscription already carries but that were never billed for its current term. One call books one added-seat billing line that bills every seat it covers, charged to the default card on file; the line covers the current term on record, from the term start date to the term end date. The licensed seat count, the plan and the term dates do not change.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `email_plan_id` | reference number of the email subscription whose seats are being billed, as returned by the email subscription lookup for this customer | identifier |
| `customer_id` | customer reference number of the subscription's holder, as returned by the customer profile lookup | identifier |
| `catch_up_amount` | the amount to bill for the seats, in US dollars | positive number with 2 decimal places; more decimals are rounded half up to the cent before booking |
| `catch_up_seats` | the number of seats the line bills | integer of at least 1 |

**Return.** On success: "Billed <seats> seat(s) on subscription <email_plan_id>: line <email_charge_id> order <order_ref> for <amount> USD covering <period_start> to <period_end>, charged to card." The order reference is HL- followed by 8 digits; the period dates are YYYY-MM-DD. A reply starting with "Error:" means nothing was booked: an unknown subscription, a non-positive amount or fewer than 1 seat.

## Points of judgement

- Seats that were billed when they were added are not a seat catch-up.
- The seat catch-up line belongs to the current term on record; it does not open a new term.
